capturedSource: Retained bodies preserve immutable original capture signatures, body hashes and live-runtime proofs; the SHA-pinned validator-only transition revalidates them under the reviewed guard against byte-identical rendering inputs. Fresh batches record their actual current tool/source signature. Every gzip remains bound to current serving source hashes.
interactionOnlyRationale: Submission-only scripts are validated at each build to register only user-interaction listeners and perform no DOM writes, network, timers or load-event work before interaction. Crawlable body, translated data, render scripts and archive hashes remain pinned.
